Turning Complexity into Clarity.

We help technology-driven companies make clearer product and market decisions — and turn strategic choices into action.

Explore how we help → What are you trying to solve? →
Independent Product Strategy Partner · Switzerland
The question
When the technology is clear, but the decision isn't.

AXIVIA brings structure to complex product and market decisions — so leadership teams can see the options, make the trade-offs, and move forward.

01 — The challenge

The difficult part is often deciding what matters.

Technology evolves quickly. Markets shift. Customer expectations change.

The difficult part is often not understanding what is possible — but deciding what matters, what to prioritise, and what to do next.

AXIVIA helps turn complexity into a clear strategic direction.

02 — Approach

Understand. Decide. Act.

We focus on the decision behind the work — bringing evidence, perspective and structure to the moments that matter.

01

Understand

Clarify the situation, the evidence and the constraints around the decision.

02

Decide

Structure options, trade-offs and priorities so the strongest path becomes clear.

03

Act

Translate the strategic choice into clear priorities, practical next steps and momentum.

03 — Services

Two ways to move forward.

Two levels of engagement. A focused sprint when a decision is close; a deeper strategic partnership when the challenge needs sustained product, market and activation support.

01 — FOCUSED SPRINT

Opportunity Sprint

A focused strategic sprint to assess an opportunity, challenge assumptions and determine whether it deserves to move forward.

New opportunities · Emerging technologies · New markets · Strategic questions
Discuss an opportunity →
02 — ONGOING PARTNERSHIP

Strategic Product Partnership

Senior strategic product support for companies navigating complex product, portfolio or market decisions.

Product strategy · Portfolio decisions · Prioritisation · Strategic advisory · Product leadership
Start a conversation →
05 — Who we help

Built for decisions that matter.

Founders & CEOs

When strategic clarity is needed to move the business forward.

Product Leaders

When priorities, portfolios or product direction need to be challenged and clarified.

Technology Leaders

When technical possibilities need to be translated into meaningful product opportunities.

Business Leaders

When market opportunities require stronger product and strategic alignment.

06 — Why AXIVIA

Clarity before complexity.

01

Senior thinking.

Focused strategic expertise without unnecessary layers.

02

Evidence before assumptions.

Decisions grounded in relevant technology, user and market signals.

03

Focus on the decision.

04

07 — Our strategic lens

See the decision from every side.

We bring together the forces shaping a product decision, then connect them to identify the strongest path forward.

07 — About

A strategic partner when clarity matters.

AXIVIA is an independent product strategy partner helping technology-driven companies navigate complex product and market decisions.

We combine strategic thinking, product expertise and market perspective to help teams understand their options, make better decisions and move forward with confidence.

Our role is deliberately focused: bring clarity where complexity is slowing the next decision.

A different starting point

What are you trying to decide?

You don't need to know which service you need. Start with the situation. We'll start there too.

A useful place to start

The problems behind the brief

Sometimes the real question is hiding behind the question.

“We have the technology. We don't know where to take it.”

Clarify the strongest application, user need and market opportunity before investing further.

“We have too many opportunities. Which ones deserve investment?”

Create a decision framework and prioritise opportunities against evidence and strategic fit.

“Our product is good. The market isn't responding.”

Challenge the value proposition, positioning, adoption barriers and market assumptions.

“R&D, Product and Sales don't agree on where to go.”

Create shared clarity around the customer, the opportunity, the trade-offs and the next decision.

A glimpse into how we think

We don't start with the answer.

We build enough clarity to make a decision worth acting on.

01Question

What really needs to be decided?

02Evidence

What do we actually know?

03Options

What paths are available?

04Trade-offs

What changes if we choose one?

05Decision

What deserves commitment?

06Action

What happens next?

YB
The human partner
You don't need another consultant. You need someone to think it through with you.

AXIVIA is deliberately person-led. You work directly with the person responsible for the thinking, the questions and the outcome. No unnecessary layers, no black box — just an experienced strategic partner close to the decision.

Yannick Broillet · Founder, AXIVIA
One last question

There is probably a question behind the question.

Let's find it — together.

yannick.broillet@axivia.ch
